experiment: A0 Pointmap x Pose factorial oracle, office2 diagnostic

calibration.gauge: one final-revision trajectory Sim(3) using prefix poses only
calibration.local_unit_conversion: C = prefix global scale * first KF raw scale
calibration.scope: offline final-revision diagnostic; no claim of online prefix-only pose estimation

arms.A10: GT-depth backprojection on GT rays, estimated placement
arms.A01: predicted local geometry, GT metric SE3 placement
arms.A11: GT-depth backprojection on GT rays, GT metric SE3 placement

auxiliary_arms.Z10: GT Z-depth along predicted ray, estimated placement; ray-preserving diagnostic
auxiliary_arms.Z11: GT Z-depth along predicted ray, GT placement; ray-preserving diagnostic

scopes.strict: post-prefix self-branch KFs only; same baseline-native-active AND valid GT interior source pixels for all arms
scopes.full_map_sensitivity: all baseline-native-active candidates and prefix KFs; replace local geometry only on valid GT interior pixels; preserve other predicted local points; placement changes for all candidates

common_mask_and_native_filter: Use the frozen N1 rules; compute native mask once before GT interventions; no arm-dependent filtering or covariance reinitialization

evaluation.depth_definition: alpha-weighted expected Z-depth, numerator / compositing weight
evaluation.primary_error: mean per-frame rendered-depth MAE on all-four-arm common covered valid GT interior pixels; report the common denominator
evaluation.secondary_error: per-arm covered-valid MAE and AbsRel, all-GT coverage and correct-depth coverage; pixel counts and per-region/distance errors
evaluation.rgb: heldout PSNR and SSIM with original exposure normalization; no appearance optimization; LPIPS optional and not a geometry decision metric

surface.definition: same-view GT-depth TSDF observed-region reference; rendered-depth TSDF separate from Gaussian-center proxy
surface.nn_error_truncation: none; also report distance percentiles; distances in metres

evaluation.provided_mesh: record supplied triangulated GT mesh provenance; use point/center nearest-vertex checks only as separate proxies, not full-scene completeness
evaluation.precision: float64 coordinate contract; float32 compact CUDA renderer; TF32 disabled for all arm evaluation

sensitivity.C_changes: strict four-arm depth/coverage on the same 20 fixed fusion views at C*0.8 and C*1.25; same IDs, masks, attributes and gauge
sensitivity.default_C: strict and full-map four-arm evaluation on all 400 views, plus strict Z10/Z11 controls
sensitivity.bootstrap: no scene-level CI or significance from a single scene; frames are correlated, not independent trials

diagnostic_decision_rule.rule: Prefer A2 depth feasibility only when local contrast dominates, ray-preserving control supports it, geometry/coverage do not contradict, and C sensitivity preserves direction. Prefer A1 placement analysis for placement dominance. Otherwise REVISE, including strong interaction, gauge-dependent conclusions or large A11 residual. This is a development diagnostic, not an efficacy GO or universal causal contribution.

access_scope: office2 only; office3 remains validation, office4 remains withheld; no training, pruning/admission policy or refiner changes
